responsibility: Declares the RVV-specific `vector_costs` subclass and supporting data structures for the RISC-V vectorizer cost model. It defines program-point and cost-type bookkeeping, memory-reference tracking, VLS unrolling heuristics, unexpected-spill analysis hooks, and the overridden cost-entry points that riscv-vector-costs.cc implements, serving as the internal interface for RVV vectorization profitability and LMUL-cost analysis.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the riscv-vector-costs pair: it declares the costs class, stmt_point, cost-type enum, and analysis hooks used by the RVV vectorizer cost model, while riscv-vector-costs.cc contains the costing algorithms and heuristics themselves.
